newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends touch stronger.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends touch stronger.

text.p: White sugar futures in London finished slightly firmer on Thursday evening after earlier coming up against resistance.
Most active March pulled back after peaking at $302.70 per tonne, when resistance around $302.50 came into play, traders said.
March finished 40 cents higher at $301.60, just 60 cents off its low for the day. Support still seemed firm at the psychological $300 mark, chartists said.
In Paris, March finished 80 cents firmer at $301.80 and May 40 cents higher at $301.40.
